device: CPU only; numerical emulation, no GPU timing
fp8: E4M3FN; power-of-two static scale per chart and effective coefficient family; dequantize to FP32
int8: symmetric signed -127..127, static absmax scale per contiguous GS128 block within each chart/family; final groups zero-padded for scale calculation and sliced back
fp16: explicit half intermediates, serial half edge accumulation; CPU sum/tanh may use higher precision internally before half rounding
test: 12 Set12 images; original fixed noise and stride3 overlap reconstruction
